name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted media library for movies, series and anime with automatic metadata and on-demand transcoding.

alerts.message: The first account you register becomes the administrator. Registration stays open afterwards and every new account can browse and play right away, so set DISABLE_REGISTRATION to true once your own account exists.
Copy your video files into the kyoo-library volume. The scanner and transcoder mount it read-only and pick up new files automatically.
